_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the post-score review-volume/packaging recommendation. Edit here only. build_scorecard.py reads this file directly. Derived from the RMS pricing spreadsheet (segment bucket x business type x score band).
_segment_bucket_comment: The script derives the bucket from the Account Segment input's sub_score (already computed per scoring-model.md's 5-tier table: Strategic/Strat Ent=100, Enterprise=75, Commercial=60, Mid-Market=50, Small Business/SMB=20) rather than string-matching the raw segment text. sub_score >= 60 (Strategic/Enterprise/Commercial) -> 'Commercial/Enterprise'; sub_score < 60 (Mid-Market/SMB) -> 'SMB & MM'. If the Account Segment input is unknown, the review-volume recommendation cannot be computed.
_business_type_comment: business_type is supplied by the skill (not computed here) via a Salesforce lookup: query Account WHERE G2_Vendor_ID__c = <vendor_id from Looker product_vendor_info.vendor_id>, read Type. Map via account_type_map below. If no Account record is found or Type is unmapped, the skill defaults business_type to 'new_business' and flags it as unverified in the note -- this scoring model exists for pre-sale qualification, so an unresolved account is treated as a prospect rather than blocking the recommendation.
_gap_rule_comment: The source spreadsheet has no defined band for scores 30-39 (tables jump from '<30' to '40+'). Per operator decision, 30-39 is folded into the bottom band (extended to 0-39) rather than left unscoped.
_overlap_rule_comment: The source spreadsheet's Commercial/Enterprise New Business table has overlapping band edges (e.g. '40-60' then '60-80'). Resolved to non-overlapping bounds matching the (cleanly-bounded) Existing Customer table's pattern: 0-39 / 40-59 / 60-79 / 80-95 / 96-100. A score landing exactly on a boundary gets the higher band.
